chunks: From him, from Yahya ibn Isa, from the one who informed him, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: 'The best of foods is rice, and we cure our illnesses with it.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the benefits of rice?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates rice (al-aruzz) as the premier food, explicitly noting its therapeutic utility in treating ailments, which reflects the Prophetic tradition of viewing diet as medicine. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the medicinal properties of staple grains, aligning with the broader Islamic principle of seeking healing through permissible natural means.
